description: Visual regression check: screenshot a live page (or element), compare it to a stored baseline, and report how many pixels changed, WHERE they changed (bounding regions), and the average color shift ("blue → red"). First call saves the baseline; later calls compare. Writes a red-highlighted diff image for review.

action.description: 'baseline' overwrites the stored baseline; 'compare' (default) compares against it

actionTimeoutMs.description: How long each action waits for its element (default 10000); keep timeoutMs above the total

actions.description: Steps run in order after load to reach a state (modal, step 3). One call = one fresh browser, so include the login steps; end with a 'wait' on what the state shows

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option

channel.description: Branded Chromium to launch instead of the bundled one (must be installed)

device.description: Playwright device preset, e.g. 'iPhone 15', 'Pixel 7', 'iPad Pro 11' (viewport, user agent, touch)

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page (default false)

mode.description: 'replay' (default) answers requests from the file; 'record' saves the traffic

notFound.description: replay: requests missing from the file abort (default) or go to the network

pixelThreshold.description: Combined per-pixel channel delta considered different (default 60)

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

routes.description: Network mocks, first match wins: json/body/status fulfil, abort fails, delayMs alone slows the real request

selector.description: Capture only this element (selector or locator)

storageState.description: Logged-in session: storageState JSON inside the project, e.g. playwright/.auth/user.json

tolerance.description: Percent of pixels that may differ before reporting a change (default 0.1)

url.description: Full URL of the page (or element target) to capture

waitFor.description: Wait for this selector before capturing

name: compare-visual-state
title: Compare visual state
